ABOUT.TITLE: About Ashya
ABOUT.P1: Hi! I’m Ashya, a ceramics artist from Wroclaw, now living in the beautiful city of Hamburg.
ABOUT.P2: My work is inspired by nature. Sand and sea, rocks and waves are the elements I strive to preserve in my art. Imagine walking barefoot on warm sand by the seaside, somewhere on a wild, secluded beach. Alone, you feel the sun on your skin, and the wind in your hair, and you hear the distant sound of waves... You feel free because you are truly living in the moment. This is the feeling I get from my art, and I wish to share with people when they create with me or use my ceramics.
ABOUT.P3: Ceramics have truly changed my life. From the first moment, I was captivated by the ability to create beautiful and functional objects with my own hands. The joy of making everyday items that I could use and appreciate brought immense happiness to my life. I love to make the space around me not only functional but as well unique and unforgettably beautiful.
ABOUT.P4: In 2022, I opened my atelier with the hope of sharing the joy of ceramics with others. Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced ceramics enthusiast, my classes are tailored to meet your individual needs. I believe in working closely with each participant to ensure a fun and creative experience.
ABOUT.P5: If you'd like to learn more about me or my art, or if you have any questions, please use the contact form below. I’m excited to connect with you!
ABOUT.SIGNOFF:
Looking forward to meeting you soon.
Love, Ashya

PRIVACY_POLICY.C1_TITLE: 1. What are cookies and what is their purpose?
PRIVACY_POLICY.C1_TEXT1: Cookies are text files stored on your device, used by servers to recognize the device upon reconnection. They are downloaded every time you enter and leave a website. Cookies don't identify you personally, just your device - for instance, to adjust the displayed image to the technical capabilities of your hardware (like resolution) or its type (desktop or mobile version).
PRIVACY_POLICY.C1_TEXT2: Cookies are commonly used for counters, surveys, online stores, login-required sites, ads, and monitoring visitor activity. They enable remembering your interests and tailoring websites to them, including content and ad personalization.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C1_TEXT3: Today, virtually all online services use cookies - search engines, news sites, blogs, online stores, government sites, magazines, newspapers, etc. Our site also uses cookies.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C2_INTRO: Generally, they operate on the following principles:
PRIVACY_POLICY.C2_TEXT:
Identify the computer and browser used for web browsing - letting us know if a particular computer has visited the site before,
Data obtained from cookies are not combined with users' personal data acquired, for example, during site registration,
They are not harmful to you or your computers, smartphones - they don't affect their functioning,
They don't cause configuration changes in end devices or software installed on these devices,
Default cookie parameters allow only the server that created them to read the information,
Based on your behaviour on visited websites, they send information to servers, making the displayed page better tailored to individual preferences.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C3_TITLE: 3. What types of cookies are there?
PRIVACY_POLICY.C3_INTRO: There are several types of cookies:
PRIVACY_POLICY.C3_SESSION_TEXT: are temporary files stored in the browser memory until the end of the session (i.e., until the browser is closed). They are essential for some apps or functionalities to work correctly. They should be automatically deleted from your device upon closing the browser.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C3_PERSISTENT_TEXT: facilitate the use of frequently visited sites (e.g., remembering your favorite colour scheme or menu layout on your favorite sites). These files are stored in a designated folder for an extended period, which you can regulate in your browser settings. Each time you visit the site, data from these cookies are transmitted to the server. These cookies are sometimes called "tracking cookies".
PRIVACY_POLICY.C3_THIRDPARTY_TEXT: typically come from advertising servers, search servers, etc., cooperating with the site owner. They help tailor displayed information and ads to your interests and habits, often allowing free access to some content. They also count ad clicks, user preferences, and more.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_TITLE: 4. Do you need to consent to our use of cookies?
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_TEXT1: Remember, you have the ability to manage cookies yourself. This is possible, for example, through web browsers you use (usually, the mechanism is enabled by default). In the most popular browsers, you have the option to:
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_LIST:
Accept cookie handling, allowing you to fully enjoy the options offered by websites,
Manage cookies on an individual, selected site basis,
Define settings for different types of cookies, such as accepting persistent files as session ones, etc.,
Block or delete cookies.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_BROWSERS_INTRO: Information on enabling and disabling cookies in the most popular browsers can be found on:
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_CHROME: Google's page about Chrome browser settings (external link):
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_IE: Microsoft's page about Internet Explorer settings (external link):
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_EDGE: Microsoft's page about Microsoft Edge settings (external link):
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_FIREFOX: Mozilla's page about Firefox settings (external link):
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_OPERA: Opera Software's page about Opera settings (external link):
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_SAFARI: Apple's page about Safari settings (external link):
PRIVACY_POLICY.C4_TEXT2: Leaving your browser settings unchanged implies consent to our use of cookies. However, blocking or disabling certain types might prevent you from fully experiencing the site's functionality or disrupt its proper operation.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C5_TEXT1: On our website, we utilize both session and persistent cookies for several purposes:
PRIVACY_POLICY.C5_LIST:
Generating statistics to enhance the content, structure, and layout of our pages,
Maintaining the user's session on the site.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C5_TEXT2: For accurate page display, we gather the following data: name and version of the internet browser, language settings, date and time of the server request, IP address from which the request was sent, and the requested URL. These data are collected to ensure the proper functioning of the site.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C5_TEXT3: We use the web analytics tool – Google Analytics for creating statistics. This tool collects data and uses its own cookies in accordance with Google's Privacy Policy (external link):
PRIVACY_POLICY.C5_TEXT4: Google accumulates data on its servers from the placement of cookies on devices and uses this information to generate reports and provide other services related to internet traffic and usage. Google may also share this information with third parties if required by law or if these entities process the information on behalf of Google.
PRIVACY_POLICY.C5_TEXT5: Data collected by our site are not disclosed or shared with third parties except for competent law enforcement authorities authorized to conduct criminal proceedings in connection with a complaint filed by us. This will only happen if you engage in unlawful or harmful activities.

SHIPPING.S21_INSTRUCTIONS_TEXT: Feel free to contact me per WhatsApp {{phone}} to arrange an appointment for the pick-up.
SHIPPING.S22_TEXT1: All orders are shipped via DHL within 3-10 days after placement. For preordered items that are out of stock, shipping will occur as soon as they are available.
SHIPPING.S23_TEXT: International orders are also shipped with DHL within 3-10 days after ordering. For out-of-stock items that can be preordered, shipping will be done as soon as they are ready. Shipping costs vary based on size, weight, and destination, and you can view the exact costs during checkout. Please be aware that some countries may impose additional taxes.
SHIPPING.S24_INTRO: Estimated costs to pay for shipping:
SHIPPING.S31_TEXT1: Items can be returned within 14 days after delivery if they are unused. The customer is responsible for return shipping costs to address:
SHIPPING.S31_TEXT2: All products must be returned in their original packaging with all enclosed documentation, and the packaging cannot be broken or in any other way damaged – neither can the product. Otherwise, it will not be possible to obtain a refund. You must pay for the freight to return the goods, and this must also be arranged by yourself. The goods are your responsibility until they reach the studio. Please ensure you pack the return safely to prevent any damage to the products or boxes.
SHIPPING.S31_TEXT3: Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment, within a certain amount of days. If you receive a refund, the cost of shipping will be deducted from your refund. If you are shipping an item over €75, you should consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance.
SHIPPING.S31_TEXT4: If the item is damaged or defective, we will gladly refund the cost (we will do that after providing of the photo of the damaged item). For damaged or incorrect items, email us at {{email}} with your order number and details.
SHIPPING.S31_TEXT5: Contact us if you have any problems with your order - we are happy to help you.
SHIPPING.S32_TEXT: To exchange a product, place a new order online and return the original product for a refund.
SHIPPING.S33_TEXT: If applicable, customs or import duties will be charged once the package reaches your country. These charges are your responsibility. For more information, contact your local customs office.
SHIPPING.S4_TITLE: 4. Cancellation Policy for Events and Workshops
SHIPPING.S4_A: A) Cancellations made 15-30 days before the event are eligible for a 50% refund.
SHIPPING.S4_B: B) Cancellations within 14 days of the event are non-refundable.
SHIPPING.S4_CONTACT: For additional information contact us at {{email}}.
